name: EMODnet-compliant protected area (common)
abstract: Common GeoJSON Feature envelope and shared vocabulary bindings (country, IUCN category, major ecosystem type, EEA designation type) for protected-area features published through OGC API - Features in a form that is field-for-field compatible with the EMODnet Human Activities protected-area layers. Parent of the EMODnet target profiles (nationally designated areas, Regional Sea Convention MPAs), the Norwegian and HELCOM source profiles with their transforms, and the API collection profile.
